objective: Define the canonical architecture principles and ADR framework for a modular, provider-portable, replayable, fail-closed and proportionate NEXUS QUANT architecture before domain boundaries are frozen.
scope: Define simplicity-first architecture principles for a private <=10-user system
Define country-neutral and provider-portable architecture principles
Define modular-core-first and dedicated-service extraction criteria
Define event-time, provenance, replay and immutable-evidence principles
Define independent Risk and Pre-Trade Firewall authority principles
Define environment isolation and fail-closed behavior
Define bounded agent authority, handoff and audit principles
Create foundational ADRs needed by P02-B through P02-I
out_of_scope: Enable Demo, Shadow, Live or Auto Trading
tests: Architecture principles do not prematurely select vendors or runtime technologies
Country/location is not an architectural assumption
Risk/Firewall authority is explicitly independent from strategy and execution
Replay/provenance and deterministic recovery are first-class principles
Foundational ADR set is internally consistent
No implementation code or runtime provisioning
security_tests: Trading credentials must not require withdrawal authority
evidence: Canonical A0-A10 contracts and authority model
ADR framework and foundational ADR set
rollback: Revert P02-A architecture documents and state/catalog changes. No runtime resources or code are created.
definition_of_done: P02-B through P02-I can reference stable architecture decision rules
Task Catalog and Current State are reconciled
